svg.title: From repeat runs to a defensible comparison

g.text: From repeat runs to a defensible comparison
Same distance, same start procedure → time four separate runs
Run 1: d/t₁ Run 2: d/t₂ Run 3: d/t₃ Run 4: d/t₄
Compare the spread → investigate an unusual run before averaging
Mean speed = (v₁ + v₂ + v₃ + v₄) / 4 → compare with your prediction
Use your measured times and units. Do not invent a missing trial.
